[spoiler=[b]The Nordiheimian and Tartakum Trade Deal of 12th of September 2025[/b]]
The Copper Gun Trade
Trade deal between The United Territories of Nordiheim and The Republic of Tartakum
====================================================
With this deal the two nations of Nordiheim and Tartakum agree to adhere to the following agreements of trade:
_C__________________________________G____________________________________T_
Trade deal

1.a: Both parties agree to open their civilian markets for free trade between each others nations to encourage the flow of goods, service and refined materials.

1.b: All trade are to be done in "good fait" and with fair prices based on world market prices on a quarterly basis.

1.c: If there should be a large change or upsett in the world economy the trade prices can be changed outside of the quarterly basis if both nations agree.

++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++
Resource deal

2.a: Nordiheim opens its resource market for Iron and Aluminium to Tartakum for them to buy this resourses with currency of equal value.

2.b: Tartakum opens its resource market for Copper to Nordiheim for them to buy these resourses with currency of equal value.

2.c: The Value of the Iron, Aluminium and Copper will be based on world market prices that will be agreed on in quarterly intervalls together with the quantities of each resource.

++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++
Military purchases

3.a: Nordiheim will allow Tartakum to buy 'TED-3-B' Flash grenades, 'MSR-75' sniper rifles and 'HM-DSB 10' light weigth signal booster as they need on a quarterly bassis.

3.b: Tartakum is also allowed to buy amunition fo the 'MSR-75' aswell as spare parts and technical advice on how to use the 'HM-DSB 10' propperly.

3.c: Nordiheim agrees with the signing of this deal to deliver any remaining quanteties that are left of a allready agreed quarterly order if this trade deal were to be canceled for any reason exept for the event were the Oceanice Republics were to proclaim direct hostile intent or declare war ageinst the nation of Nordiheim.

3.d: Tartakum will not be allowed to sell, give or donate any of the 'MRS-75', TED-3-B', 'HM-DSB 10' or their parts to another nation without the permsiion of the council of Nordiheim with the exeption of members of EEHP.

++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++
Other deals

4.a: Nordiheim will be allowed to invest in the mining companies of Tartakum in return for a % share in the companies.

4.b: The ownership of majorety share (51%) will not be allowed to be gained by Nordiheim or Nordiheimian companies/organizations, allowing them only a tottal ownership of 49% in any singular Tartakum company.

5: Both nations will be allowed to open embassies in each others national capitols.

6: In the interest of cooperation Nordiheim declares a willingness to have the trade deal between them and Tartakum be open to change and/or new amendments in the future should there be need for it because of changes in either nation or the world scene that have a noticable effect on the original intention of 'The Copper Gun Deal' as long as both parties can arive at a mutual agreement to such changes.

++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++
Signatory parties
Diplomatic delegation of The United Regions of Nordiheim ___________________________________ Entrusted Diplomat of The Republic of Tartakum[/spoiler]
